# Only the math functions that build a special value from invariant arguments are
# invariant. Anything else in math, and a call whose argument changes every
# iteration, stays scalar.

cp ops.go ops.go.orig
loopvec -split .
! stdout .
! stderr .
! exists ops_simd.go
cmp ops.go ops.go.orig

loopvec -json .
cmpenv stdout stdout.want

-- go.mod --
module example.com/test

go 1.27.1
-- ops.go --
package test

import "math"

func Floor(out []float64) {
	for i := range out {
		out[i] = math.Floor(2.5)
	}
}

func InfOfIndex(out []float64) {
	for i := range out {
		out[i] = math.Inf(i)
	}
}

func BitsOfElement(out []float32, bits []uint32) {
	for i := range out {
		out[i] = math.Float32frombits(bits[i])
	}
}
-- stdout.want --

{"file":"$WORK/ops.go","line":12,"func":"InfOfIndex","vectorized":false,"reason":"operand is not a same-index slice, range value, or plain scalar","stage":"lower"}
{"file":"$WORK/ops.go","line":18,"func":"BitsOfElement","vectorized":false,"reason":"operand is not a same-index slice, range value, or plain scalar","stage":"lower"}
